The '''Avilatan Badlands''' was a region of the island of [[Avilatan]] on the planet of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The majority of the area was covered in craters.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist]] forces often fought in the badlands. Many traps, such as mines, were placed in the badlands in an attempt to kill enemy forces. Republic troops often placed wagers on competitors trying to disarm mines.

An important road led through the Badlands. Separatist forces attempted to ambush Republic convoys traveling through the Badlands.

The Badlands also bordered the Republic's outpost of [[Fort Garnik]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Avilatan Badlands first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
